summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by ICICI Bank Ltd, a foreign private issuer, disclosing an upcoming Board meeting to approve Q1 2026 unaudited financial results and a related insider trading window closure as required under SEBI regulations. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, capital return, rights offering, SPAC, or management change is announced. The document is a routine regulatory notice confirming an ordinary board meeting and blackout period. As this is purely operational and procedural with no special-situation event, it falls outside the defined categories.
